name: Tiny Fuppets
overview: Comedy writer Scott Gairdner's parody of Vídeo Brinquedo's shameless ripoffs of Pixar and DreamWorks Animation movies. Tiny Fuppets is supposed to be a Captain Ersatz version of Muppet Babies. Characters include Kormit (Kermit, Ms. Woman (Miss Piggy), Gonzor (Gonzo), Tummi (Fozzie Bear), and Animanuel (Animal).
